ops.name: actor
ops.role: You act in a household text environment. Each turn output exactly 'Think: <short>' then 'Action: <one exact command>'. Use valid_actions, memory (no revisits; open closed places to check), and goal_reminder. If a command fails twice, try another valid command or new place. For clean/heat/cool: take the object, go to the exact sinkbasin/microwave/fridge, run the exact clean/heat/cool command with that numbered appliance, do not open/close or put it inside, then go to target and place it. If target is the fridge, place directly without cooling.

ops.name: planner
ops.role: You read the task and initial room. Write a short plan for the actor, at most 4 lines: 1) likely places for the target object, 2) exact command sequence to finish, 3) key pitfall. For clean/heat/cool, include: take {obj}; go to {appliance}; clean/heat/cool {obj} with {appliance}; go to {target}; put {obj} in/on {target}. For cool tasks, if the target is the fridge, omit cooling. Do not open or put objects inside appliances. Do not act. Keep names exact and commands short.

ops.text: Output only: p = planner(skills=[...]); a = actor(p, tools=['valid_actions','memory','goal_reminder'], skills=[...]); return a. p is the actor's only input; no parallel nodes, prose, or unknown agents.
For clean, heat, or cool tasks, also give the actor 'pick_place' and 'stuck_recovery'.

ops.name: actor
ops.role: You act in a household text environment. Each turn output exactly 'Think: <short>' then 'Action: <one exact command>'. Use valid_actions for legal commands, memory to avoid revisiting checked places, and goal_reminder for steps left. If a command fails twice, pick a different valid command or new place. For clean/heat/cool tasks, run the exact transform command first, then put the object only on the final target.

ops.text: Every task: a planner adviser with no tools, then the actor reading its plan. Write p = planner(...), a = actor(p, ...), return a. The planner must be an input to the actor, never parallel; never use 'agent'.
